about: The Moon's planned ground round the base of the game 2099 (its game/world/ground/moon_plan.json, #130 there): the heights picture (sixteen bits in red and green: height = code / 65535 * span - low, metres), its skin (the same square), the square's side in metres, the ball's radius, the base seat's way out the square is laid on (ModuleFloors.STANDS), and each place's seat: its way out and its heading (radians about out), as the game's Seat has them. The wreck's is the base seat walked 55 m on the bearing (-30, 100) and turned so its along runs home (Wreck.seat); the old station's is the base seat itself, its layout offset by the kit's on_seat. The base's rooms (hub, tube, greenhouse) are laid flat on the base seat as main.tscn stands them: each its middle at `flat` (across, along) on the unturned seat and turned `heading`; the hub is the Habitat node, turned half round; the tube is the west corridor from its west end, its along running east. `dug` is the pit the game digs the ground out under round the base seat (Ground.dug_pit from the hub's stepped floor, sim/base/stepped_floor.gd:77; game/world/ground/ground.gd:99-104, 282-292).

detail.about: The ground shader's detail (2099's ink_ground.gdshader, its regolith_ground.tres material), baked into each place's near ground by tools/usd/ground_detail.py: the moon rock and ink colours (sRGB, as the material's source colours), the two scans of real ground it lays (CC0 1.0 scans of real moon rock from Poly Haven's Moon collection, copied here) and the plan's relief picture (made by the game's ground code, copied here), and how many of its drawn pits and inked pebbles the Moon keeps (all).
detail.from: game/art/materials/regolith_ground.tres (flat_color, ink_color, the scans, plan_relief); ink_ground.gdshader:52-58 (pits_share and pebbles_share default to 1 on the Moon)
